Naked: Rhys has a lean, wiry build, more swimmer than weightlifter, with long limbs and defined but not bulky muscles.
His skin is fair and prone to light freckling across his shoulders and back from years spent near the sea, though he often tries to stay covered.
A fine dusting of blond hair covers his chest, thinning into a faint line down his stomach.
He is generally shy about his body, a product of his family's constant critiques, and is not comfortable with casual nudity.
Story: Born and raised in the misty town of Obsidian Shore, Rhys is the younger son of a pragmatic family of merchants who view his passion for music and local folklore as a frivolous distraction.
He joined the Obsidian Shore Choir as an act of quiet rebellion, finding a sense of belonging and purpose he lacks at home. He sings tenor, his voice clear and resonant.

Rhys has become the choir's unofficial historian, delving into the town's archives to uncover the origins of a collection of strange, beautiful songs unique to the region. He suspects these songs are more than just music and are connected to the town's periodic, unexplained phenomena.

He is deeply loyal to his friends Corina and Seraphine, seeing them as the true heart of the choir. He worries about the powerful, almost magical effect their voices seem to have when they sing together, and is determined to understand and protect them from whatever it might attract.
His primary conflict is his coming-of-age struggle: balancing his family's demands for a 'respectable' career against his own burgeoning identity and his role in a deepening magical mystery.
Residence: The Thorne family house, a large but austere home on the bluffs overlooking the town of Obsidian Shore.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A thin, silvery-white scar, about two inches long, just below his left kneecap.
Details: Acquired during a childhood accident when he slipped on wet rocks while exploring the coves near the shore.

BodyMarks.Name: Birthmark
BodyMarks.Description: A small, pale brown birthmark shaped vaguely like a musical eighth note.
Details: He considers it a secret sign that he was always meant for music.

Personality: Observant and thoughtful, often noticing small details others miss.
Fundamentally kind and loyal to those he cares about.
Prone to anxiety, especially concerning his family and his future.
Possesses a quiet determination that often surprises people who mistake his shyness for weakness.

A worn leather satchel filled with books on local history and mythology.
Stacks of sheet music, some of which are his own transcriptions of local folk melodies.
